column3: MT 7:2. NKJV adds the heading “THE BELOVED”; “a noble” is rendered “prince’s.”
MT 7:3. Close to the Hebrew; “mixed wine” is rendered “blended beverage,” and “belly” “waist.”
MT 7:6. Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “crowns” and “Mount,” and “bound” is rendered “held captive.”
MT 7:9. Close to the Hebrew; “I say” is rendered “I said,” and “your nose” “your breath.”
MT 7:10. NKJV splits the verse with the heading “THE SHULAMITE”; “your mouth” (palate) is rendered “the roof of your mouth.”
MT 7:12. Close to the Hebrew; “pass the night” is rendered “lodge.”
MT 7:13. Close to the Hebrew; “my loves” is rendered “my love.”
MT 7:14. Close to the Hebrew; “over our doors” is rendered “at our gates,” and NKJV supplies “fruits.”
